Watching leadcommand-conversation 254bae26-e905-4982-963a-0b066359e64b on this connection: new seller messages and delivery changes will be posted here and Sterling will be asked to act.

@Sterling find the seller conversations we overlooked in LeadCommand, read the one that matters in full, record what the seller actually said, bring in Equity and Haven, and decide the follow-up. Anything contractual goes to Clara.

Overlooked conversation found: 2 unanswered seller messages in the last 30 days; the one that matters is 4471 Marigold Ln, Indianapolis, IN 46203 (thread 254bae26…).

The seller wrote, eleven days ago and never answered (quoted as data): “Yes I still own it. The roof needs some work though, is that a problem for you?” (message 5c6ec283…).

Recorded in LeadCommand through the gateway, bound to that message: ownership confirmed (STATEMENT_RECORDED), the roof condition in the seller's words (STATEMENT_RECORDED), the context note (ANNOTATION_RECORDED); temperature set to warm on the seller's words (HANDOFF_QUEUED) — LeadCommand's own lead-state registry applies it. No price has been stated; none will be invented.

@Equity what would 4471 Marigold Ln, Indianapolis, IN 46203 underwrite to with a roof repair, from evidence only. @Haven what is buyer demand in 46203? @Clara anything contractual before we answer the seller?
@Equity @Haven Sterling found the conversation above — Equity, what does 4471 Marigold Ln underwrite to with a roof repair, from evidence only; Haven, what is buyer demand in 46203?
Market read for 46203: no buyer index on record in this dataset — demand stays unknown, not assumed. Recorded the seller's interest on the thread (ANNOTATION_RECORDED).

Read the property record (on record) and the acquisition score (none on record). With no stated price and a roof the seller flags, I will not put a number on it before comps; recorded that as context on the thread (ANNOTATION_RECORDED). @Clara nothing from me needs a contract decision yet.
@Clara anything contractual before we answer this seller?

Transactions view: nothing contractual has been offered or accepted; a reply that asks about the roof and the timeline is fine. Escalate to me before any price, offer, assignment or agreement is communicated — those are mine to clear. @Sterling the floor is yours: decide the follow-up and send through the certified path.
